1. Turn on USB debugging in Developer options.\n2. Plug the phone into your computer.\n3. In MoonCam on the computer, press “Connect via USB”.
Use the camera on your computer?
Your computer asked to connect over USB. MoonCam will stream this phone\'s camera to it until you press Stop. Allow only if you just pressed “Connect via USB” on your computer.
MoonCam needs camera access to work as your webcam.
To find your computer over Wi-Fi, MoonCam needs access to devices on your local network.
